dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparsely distributed, diffuse high-luminance clusters with poorly defined margins; one singular high-intensity white pixel cluster is visible in the posterior-ventral region of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Uneven, notch-like serrations along the posterior margin; a small, dark low-luminance focal point is situated near the geometric center of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark pigmentation at the distal-most tip of the leading edge.
